name: Stargaze
summary: A star rating drawn as a constellation: stars ignite, lines join them and a meteor posts it
about: A hotel review form set in a twinkling sky. The five rating stars form a small constellation: hover or pick one and the stars light up in turn while glowing lines join them, and five stars ends in a burst. Posting the review sends it off as a shooting star and the form flips to a thank-you card.
how: Hover the stars to preview, then click or tap one; with the keyboard use Tab and the arrow keys
The word under the sky changes from Poor to Stellar and the hint asks a matching question
Tick what you liked and add an optional note (160 characters, with a live counter)
Press Post review to see the spinner and a shooting star, then Rate again to start over
